title: Water treatment plant storage room key

infobox.usage: Unlocks a storage room at the water treatment plant on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Water treatment plant storage room key (WTP store) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key that opens the storage room, located somewhere at the water treatment plant.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a possible location for the quest To the Light - Getting Acquainted

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: On the first floor of office building #2, which is located at the water treatment plant area in the north of Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x Technical Supply Crate
- 1x Toolbox
- Loose military tech
- Posters
- Valuables
